description:
What this is. Overtime is requested first, then paid against the clock. An approved Overtime Request says who works overtime over a day, a week, a month or any date range, and for how many hours a day; Bulk Overtime pays each of those the lower of the requested hours and what their attendance shows, and creates an Overtime Slip for each employee.

What to do. Choose the company and the period, click Get Overtime, check the rows, then submit.

Where to find it. Bulk Overtime in the menu on the left.
name: Run a Bulk Overtime Batch
title: Bulk Overtime — pay overtime for a group
